ui_bugs.issue: BITSAT exam cannot be selected in the Rapid Fire scope sheet. No testID starting with rf-scope-exam-* or rf-exam-* exists in the sheet DOM; the scope only exposes JEE subjects (PCM + English + Reasoning). As a result D1.4 cannot be executed: picking 'Mixed English' + SAVE + Start produces rf-session-exam='JEE · ...' and rf-summary-exam='JEE · Solo Sprint', not BITSAT. If the exam switcher lives elsewhere (lobby, header) it is also not exposed with a testID. Repro: open rf-chapter-picker → rf-scope-sheet → inspect testIDs starting with 'rf-scope'. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter120/d14_bitsat_sheet.jpeg. Suggested fix: add exam tabs/testIDs rf-scope-exam-jee and rf-scope-exam-bitsat at the top of the scope sheet, store the exam in the scope state, send it as POST body exam="BITSAT" and render it on rf-session-exam and rf-summary-exam.

Tapping rf-scope-mixed-<subject> when the subject is currently active does NOT deselect it reliably. During D1.3 and D2 Chemistry I tried to clear existing picks by re-tapping the active mixed chips — this either kept them selected or ended up adding more chips (D2 Chemistry: trying to go to Chemistry-only ended with Physics+English+Reasoning in the tray, Chemistry never activated). The chips do not expose aria-pressed/aria-checked so automation cannot see state; also behaviour from a human tester perspective is confusing. Repro: pick PCM Mixed (3/5), open sheet, tap rf-scope-mixed-physics — the chip stays active. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter120/d11_pcm_picked.jpeg. Suggested fix: make rf-scope-mixed-* a toggle (click when active removes the subject from picks AND removes the chip from the tray); expose aria-checked='true'/'false' on each chip for testing; also expose rf-scope-tray-remove-<id> close buttons on the tray chips (currently I could not find them).

Rounds exited via rf-exit-discard (Leave without saving) are appearing in the Solo history as 0/30 rows (e.g. '0/30 | Solo Sprint · Mixed | Mixed Maths · 21 Nov', '0/30 | Solo Sprint · Mixed | PCM Mixed · 21 Nov'). The handoff states 'Rounds left with Leave without saving must NOT be listed'. Multiple such rows exist in this iteration — some may be from earlier iterations, but at least one '0/30 Mixed Maths' corresponds to the D3 start-another round I left via rf-exit-discard this call. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter120/d4_solo_history.jpeg. Suggested fix: do not POST session completion when user chooses 'Leave without saving'; backend should reject sessions that have not been committed. Alternative: filter these out on the history endpoint.

After tapping rf-done from a Solo history review row, the user lands on /rapid (lobby) instead of the Trophy > My matches tab. Handoff: 'you must land back on the Trophy tab / My matches'. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter120/d4_after_done.jpeg. Coins stayed at 94 (correct — no re-award). Suggested fix: review-mode rf-done should router.back() or navigate to /trophy?tab=matches rather than /rapid.

rf-scope-count-30 / -50 / -100 do not set aria-checked='true'/'false' when selected. All three return aria-checked=None even though the tile correctly updates to '50 cards · 20 s' / '100 cards · 20 s'. Impacts testability. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter120/d11_count50.jpeg. Suggested fix: add role='radio' + aria-checked to the count pills (or aria-pressed on buttons).

When rf-history-tab-duels has no rows the UI does not render a rf-history-empty testID (empty: None in evaluate()); the area appears blank. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter120/d4_duels.jpeg. Suggested fix: when the duels list is empty render a message element with testID='rf-history-empty' and copy such as 'No duels yet — challenge a friend!'.

rca_of_issue: D1.4 BITSAT missing — Root cause: ScopeSheet.tsx (/app/frontend/src/rapid/ScopeSheet.tsx) renders only subject tabs and mixed chips; the scope state model (scope.ts) has no exam axis. Client-side POST body in session.tsx (or the session start helper) hardcodes exam='JEE'. Reproduction: open rf-chapter-picker, inspect page.evaluate("Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]')).map(e=>e.getAttribute('data-testid')).filter(t=>t.includes('exam'))") → returns []. Pick Mixed English + SAVE + start → POST body shows exam:'JEE' and picks:[Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics] (even English doesn't carry through if other mixes are active). rf-session-exam reads 'JEE · Physics · Magnetic Effects of Current'. Fix: add exam tabs at the top of ScopeSheet (testIDs rf-scope-exam-jee / rf-scope-exam-bitsat); include exam in scope state; map state.exam → POST body; render state.exam on session + summary headers. D4 discard-leak — Root cause suspicion: /app/backend/server.py rf session commit endpoint (POST /api/rf/sessions/<id>/finish or similar) is being called on rf-exit-discard as well as rf-exit-finish, or history endpoint returns all sessions regardless of finished flag. Reproduction: start Solo Sprint, immediately rf-exit → rf-exit-discard, open Trophy → My matches → Solo sprints: a '0/30' row appears. Fix: the client should not send any 'finish' POST on discard, and the history list should filter sessions where finished=true AND committed=true.
